title: Probe message protocol
description: Untrusted page messages validated and refused by type guards
body: The conversation between this app and the probe inside the page it is showing. The probe is `src-tauri/src/apps/design_probe.js`. Everything arriving is **untrusted**, so this module's real job is not decoding but refusing: `readProbeMessage` returns `null` for anything it cannot fully account for, and the app treats `null` as silence.
